title: Zesty Indian Paneer Curry
description: A tangy and flavorful Indian dish featuring paneer in a rich and creamy curry sauce, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the paneer cubes until golden brown.
Remove the paneer from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add more oil if necessary and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Stir in the curry powder and garam masala and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato puree and dark brown soft sugar, and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the sauce thickens.
Add the fried paneer cubes back into the pan and stir to coat with the curry sauce.
Reduce heat to low and stir in the yogurt.
Simmer the curry for 5 minutes or until the sauce has thickened to your liking.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot.
